name: rea-enhancement
description: Tampermonkey userscript for realestate.com.au rentals: available-from filter, every results page in one list, shortlist and exports. Runs locally.

scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=rea-availability-filter.user.js test/*.test.js && COVERAGE=1 node test/e2e/smoke.js && COVERAGE=1 COVERAGE_APPEND=1 node test/e2e/edge.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:setup: npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund playwright@1.56.1 && npx playwright install chromium
